title: OpenAI launches Businesses in ChatGPT: Here's how it works
summary: OpenAI launches Businesses in ChatGPT with dedicated enterprise workflow features
detailed: OpenAI launched Businesses in ChatGPT, enabling companies to set up free business profiles and build branded customer-facing agents.
Agent creation is currently restricted to eligible US e-commerce and online service businesses, though profiles are open to all.
Product teams are advised to audit how ChatGPT describes their products, ensure alignment with existing support bots, and monitor discovery traffic.
This matters because it changes how customers discover, research, and evaluate products before ever visiting a company's official website.
sentences: What happens when customers discover your product, ask questions and compare alternatives before they ever reach your website?
This week on Now Shipping, Mike Belsito breaks down Businesses in ChatGPT, exploring business profiles, branded agents, and the questions product teams should ask before getting involved.

He also looks at Reddit Reviews and what these different approaches could mean for how customers discover and judge your product.
— Run the five-question test in ChatGPT this week.
Ask what your product does, what it costs, how it compares, whether it works with the tools customers already use, and what people complain about.

Log every wrong, stale or missing answer, then repeat in a few weeks.
— Claim your profile even if you can’t build an agent.
It is free and open to any business.

Agents are limited to eligible US e-commerce and online service businesses for now.
— Don’t hand the agent to whoever owns the ads budget.
It is a customer-facing product experience.

Decide what it may promise on price and availability, what it says when it doesn’t know, and when it hands off to a person.
— Check that your two agents agree.
If you already run a support bot, make sure it and the ChatGPT agent say the same thing about returns and shipping.

Decide who updates both.
— Define a good outcome now.
You will see mentions and clicks, not conversations.

Work out how you would attribute a sale that follows a chat two days earlier.
— Mine discovery topics as research.

They show the themes in conversations where your site is cited, from people who may never have visited it.
— Keep your catalogue, pricing and policies clean and portable.

OpenAI hasn’t described a data export, and the free tier probably won’t last.
— Give product a seat on AI-described-company ownership.
Put product, support, marketing and legal in a room for 30 minutes with the five questions on screen.
